worked_solution:
Suppose $x$ is a real number. The greatest integer (or floor) function $⌊x⌋$ equals the greatest integer that is smaller than or equal to $x:$

$$
⌊x⌋=n,\,\text{where}\,n\le x<n+1,\,n\in Z.
$$

From the definition of the greatest integer function, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}⌊-42⌋=-42.\end{aligned}
$$
